column3: The Hebrew says “I love, for Yahweh hears”; NASB makes the LORD the object (“I love the LORD, because He hears”).
Close to the Hebrew; “in my days” is rendered “as long as I live,” and NASB adds “Therefore” and “Him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the distresses of Sheol” is rendered “the terrors of Sheol,” and “found me” as “came upon me.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural “resting places” is rendered “rest.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my life” is rendered “my soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lands” is rendered “land.”
“I believed, for I said” is rendered “I believed when I said.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “when I was hastening” is rendered “in my alarm.”
Close to the Hebrew; the particle “please” is rendered “Oh may it be.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for I am your servant” is rendered “surely I am Your servant.”
Close to the Hebrew; the particle “please” is rendered “Oh may it be.”
